label: Configuration Studio
description: How the workspace behaves — one place to tune every module, decide who can do what, and set the defaults the rest of the platform runs on.
lockedNote: Fixed by the Act — cannot be changed
comingSoonDescription: This section's settings aren't wired up in the preview build. Everything else in Configuration Studio is live.
accessDescription: Roles decide what a person can see, edit and sign across every module — one access level per module, because permission checkboxes multiply and meaning dies. Eight system roles cover the usual cast; build your own for everything else.
newRoleDescription: Describe what this role is for.
toastRoleNameRequired: Give the role a name first.
accessLoadErrorDescription: Something went wrong loading roles and permissions. Please try again.
accessFooterNote: Each level includes the ones before it. Assigning people to roles arrives with the user directory.
roleAdminDescription: Full control of every module — and of the workspace itself.
roleDpoDescription: Signs what the Act holds the fiduciary to — DPIAs, RoPA, notices, breach filings.
roleComplianceDescription: Runs the day-to-day programme — assessments, registers, evidence.
roleDsrOfficerDescription: Owns data principal requests end to end — the s.13 channel.
roleLegalDescription: Reviews and drafts — notices, processor contracts, assessments.
roleAuditorDescription: Reads everything, changes nothing — evidence, registers, trails.
roleEmployeeDescription: Takes the awareness course and completes actions assigned to them.
roleViewerDescription: Sees every register; changes nothing, approves nothing.
workspaceDescription: The legal entity behind the tenant. What you set here flows into notices, Board filings and every generated document.
footerHint: Changes apply workspace-wide · kept in the audit log
workspaceLogoDescription: Shown in the sidebar, the topbar and on every published notice. PNG, JPG or SVG — square works best.
legalNameDescription: Appears on notices, DPIAs and the readiness report.
sectorDescription: Shapes the sectoral rules the platform flags — RBI, IRDAI, health records.
languagesDescription: Every form label, helper text and notice can be written in these. s.5(3) lets a data principal read in English or any Eighth Schedule language.
dpoDescription: Published under s.8(9) — lands in every notice and on the grievance page.
publishDpoLabel: Publish the DPO contact on the public notice page
publishDpoDescription: s.8(9) requires the business contact of the DPO or a person able to answer.
notificationsDescription: Deadlines, owner confirmations, overdue actions and breach clocks — where they land and how often.
emailDescription: Owner confirmations, sign-off requests, SLA warnings.
whatsappDescription: Reminders for owners who live in WhatsApp, not email.
escalateLabel: Escalate overdue items to the admin
escalateDescription: Anything past its date copies the workspace admin.
assessmentTitle: How readiness and impact assessments run
assessmentDescription: The cadence and defaults behind the readiness score, plus the triggers that turn on a DPIA.
pushGapsLabel: Push gaps to the Issue Register automatically
pushGapsDescription: Every finding becomes an owned, dated issue the moment a run completes.
childrenDpiaLabel: Children's data always requires a DPIA
childrenDpiaDescription: s.10(2)(a) read with s.9 — not optional.
dpoSignOffDescription: No DPIA completes on the assessor's word alone.
boardWindowDescription: Rule-prescribed — the Data Protection Board within 72 hours.
awarenessDescription: Enrolment and training defaults for everyone in the register.
autoEnrolDescription: A new employee gets the agent and the DPDP course on day one.
recertDescription: Everyone repeats the course after this long.
departmentDescription: The department name used across the People register and forms.
departmentNameDescription: Shown wherever a department is picked or listed.
departmentEmptyDescription: Add your first department above — it'll show up in the Employees form right after.
departmentLoadError: Couldn't load departments. Try reloading the page.
departmentDeleteConflict: Move its employees to another department first.
masterDescription: Shared name lists your forms pick from — departments and the Gap Assessment's own sections and questions.
sectionsDescription: Each section becomes its own step in the Gap Assessment wizard.
sectionNameDescription: Shown as a step title in the Gap Assessment wizard.
sectionEmptyDescription: Add your first section above — the Gap Assessment wizard picks it up right after.
questionsEmptyDescription: No questions in this section yet. Add one below.
questionPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Do you keep a register of vendors who process personal data?
questionRemedyPlaceholder: Shown in the gap report when this fails.
questionDeleteConflict: This question already has recorded answers.
